title: Herbal Steak Wrap
description: A delicious and healthy vegetarian wrap filled with grilled sirloin and topped with herbal flavors. Perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.

ingredients.name: Chewy herbal mix
ingredients.notes: Chopped fresh herbs like parsley, basil, and cilantro

ingredients.name: Sirloin
ingredients.notes: Vegetarian sirloin substitute like portobello mushrooms or eggplant

ingredients.name: Steak seasoning
ingredients.notes: Garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika

ingredients.name: Tips
ingredients.notes: Chopped fresh herbs like parsley, basil, and cilantro

instructions: Season the sirloin with steak seasoning and grill for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
While the sirloin is grilling, mix the herbal mix and tips.
Slice the grilled sirloin into thin strips.
Warm the Algerian wrap in the microwave or on the grill.
Assemble the wrap by placing the sirloin strips on the wrap, followed by the herbal mix and tips.
